facts.fact: autoStartChunks is 300, most chunks agent-started import job may run without user's consent.
Run returns ErrRunnerBusy when another runner holds store's lock; supported state.
Only Agent option required in RunnerOptions.
Runner schedules bulk imports through scan, materialise, extract, finalize stages.
Exactly one Runner runs per memory.db, held by exclusive flock.
Runner polls job rows written by control side (Engine), so pause or cancel from another process takes effect within one tick.
All Runner state lives in memory.db, so halted runner resumes from disk.
NewRunner takes no lock; Run takes store's runner lock and works until ctx ends or store idle for IdleExit.
Runner taking lock resets what crashed predecessor left mid-flight (running jobs become paused, scanning jobs rescan) and never resumes a job by itself.
tryExit releases lock, then checks once more for work written by control call meanwhile, because job set running just before release would otherwise find no runner; if work exists, retakes lock.
On shutdown with recover, running jobs end paused as interrupted and in-flight chunks go back to pending; idle exit has nothing to recover.
Pause, cancel and finish disarm job's context, which kills its in-flight calls.
sync reads job states written by control side: running jobs get context, jobs that left running lose theirs, scanning jobs get scan, finished jobs settle.
plan skips duplicates and already imported content with reason, and chunks remaining files once to size job.
schedule starts work in order: extract workers for pending chunks, cross-check workers, reading and chunking next file, then single finalize worker.
materialiseNext reads, validates, hashes and chunks next pending file.
settle finishes job whose files are all terminal.
retry uses exponential backoff; fatal errors, spent budget and cancelled context stop it at once, and rate limit holds every other worker back until its wait is over.
runVerify cross-checks file's questionable facts against copy of its source one batch at a time, saving each batch's verdicts before next so interrupted run keeps them.
tooManyFacts guards step-2 prompt size; file over limit fails instead of being truncated.
